title: Decathlon France customer data breach, Nov 2026

subject.name: Decathlon
subject.about: Decathlon is a French company that designs and sells sporting goods for all levels, founded in 1976. It has about 1,800 stores worldwide, 325 of them in France, and sells online at decathlon.fr.

disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Decathlon, any news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: A major retailer across France. The posted files hold about 137,500 distinct email addresses, by one outlet's count; Decathlon has not said how many customers are affected.
who_is_affected: Some people who ordered on decathlon.fr: their names, phone numbers, postal addresses and delivery details. Decathlon says bank details and passwords were not affected and it will email those concerned. Be wary of unexpected messages about a parcel or delivery fee.

known.text: Decathlon says someone got malicious access to customer data at one of its outside providers on Nov 22.
The data includes names, phone numbers and addresses of some customers who ordered on decathlon.fr.
Decathlon says it blocked the access and will email the customers concerned.

figures.label: Malicious access
